titleEn: PHP runtime vulnerabilities: Japanese advisory and vendor corroboration
titleJa: PHP の複数の脆弱性：日本語注意喚起と開発元情報の照合
summary: Recorded official-source metadata captured on 24 October 2026. The synthetic SakuraShop inventory declares PHP 8.3.35; a reviewed candidate updates to PHP 8.3.36 and includes a separate startup-setting mitigation.
body: Recorded normalized facts: JPCERT-AT-2026-0033, published 2026-10-22, references CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. PHP 8.3 releases before 8.3.36 require the reviewed branch update. PHP published a separate configuration-dependent session upload-progress follow-up on 2026-10-23. For the owned synthetic fixture, propose the reviewed PHP 8.3.36 image, consistent Composer floor and disabled upload progress at startup. A declaration is not proof of deployed runtime; deployment, web configuration and incident review remain human-owned. This is a factual brief, not a full advisory reproduction.
ownerTasks: Human review and deployment of the pinned candidate image are required; this draft does not change a running service.
Verify startup upload-progress configuration and serializer behavior in the actual web deployment, then restart relevant workers.
Review PHP/JPCERT incident guidance and retained logs; these fixture checks do not prove absence of compromise or reproduce the RCE.
